title: Reasoning Depth and Environment Complexity: A Controlled Study of RLVR Data Allocation across Logical Reasoning Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2605.26934v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become central to post-training reasoning models, yet a key limitation of existing studies is their narrow view of the reasoning space: difficulty is treated as reasoning depth alone, and reward is concentrated on forward deductive state tracking. We instead characterize the reasoning space along two dimensions. Difficulty. Beyond reasoning depth, we study environment complexity, where models must identify the correct path amid distractors and interacting structures. Rewarded reasoning form. We consider four abilities core to real-world reasoning: deductive state tracking, abductive recovery of hidden events or facts, inductive rule induction, and analogical transfer. To disentangle these factors, we construct a synthetic knowledge-graph environment with controlled pre- and post-training distributions, where each instance varies along depth, complexity, and task family.

translated_title: 推理深度与环境复杂度：逻辑推理任务中RLVR数据分配的受控研究
translated_abstract: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为推理模型后训练的核心方法，然而现有研究的一个关键局限在于其对推理空间的狭隘认识：难度仅被视为推理深度，且奖励集中于前向演绎状态追踪。我们转而从两个维度刻画推理空间。难度方面：除推理深度外，我们还研究环境复杂度，即模型必须在干扰项和相互作用的结构中识别出正确路径。被奖励的推理形式方面：我们考虑了现实世界推理中四种核心能力：演绎状态追踪、溯因推理恢复隐藏事件或事实、归纳规则归纳以及类比迁移。为了解耦这些因素，我们构建了一个预训练和后训练分布均受控的合成知识图谱环境，其中每个实例在深度、复杂度和任务族三个维度上有所变化。
tldr: 该研究突破了以往仅将难度视为推理深度的局限，从难度（含推理深度与环境复杂度）和被奖励的推理形式（四种核心推理能力）两个维度刻画推理空间，并构建受控的合成知识图谱环境以系统研究RLVR数据在逻辑推理任务中的分配问题。
en_tdlr: This study moves beyond viewing difficulty as mere reasoning depth by characterizing the reasoning space along difficulty (reasoning depth and environment complexity) and rewarded reasoning form (four core reasoning abilities), and constructs a controlled synthetic knowledge-graph environment to systematically study RLVR data allocation across logical reasoning tasks.
